messages:
aj: Heads up — we have a promotional credit from GCP that is slated to expire 2024-05-15. Can finance reapply it to 2024-04 invoice or ask rep for extension? The billing console shows it as 'promotional' not 'contract'.

maria: Which billing account/project? Promo codes vary. If it's a partner promo they usually apply at billing-account level and sometimes can't be backdated.

aj: Billing account: redwood-enterprise-001, project: redwood-prod, invoice: INV-20240430-789. Promo ID: GC-REDWOOD-PRM-50K. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/billing/accounts/0000

samira: FYI — handled these before. GCP promotional credits are consumed before invoice credits and often expire if unused. We can ask rep to either extend or apply to a past invoice but it's not guaranteed. File needs invoice number + billing account.

liam: Sales had a contact (Elena at GCP). @maria I can intro if you want.

maria: Please intro. Also need to know if this was issued as part of our 'Contract credit' line (deducted as invoice offset) or a 'Promotional credit' (time-limited). Contract credits are usually recorded on each invoice as an applied credit line.

aj: It was listed as 'Promotional credit' in the email from the partner.

billing-bot: Reminder: Promotional credits expire 30 days after issue. See https://cloud.google.com/billing/docs/credits

samira: Quick Q — if we move Reserved Capacity (committed use discounts / committed spend) onto this billing account, will that change how credits apply? Short answer: credits offset charges, including committed-use line items, but commitments are billed monthly based on terms.

maria: Correct. Credits generally offset the total invoice amount after commitments are charged. But if the credit type is restricted, it may only apply to certain SKU groups. We'll confirm with rep.

aj: Action items: (1) @liam please intro to Elena; (2) @maria file support case with invoice id and promo id; (3) @samira confirm whether our Reserved pool is on the same billing account.

liam: Intro sent — Elena looped in.

maria: Support case opened: CASE-20240501-1122. Submitted invoice and promo ID. Reply expected within 48 hours.

samira: Confirmed: Reserved pool is billed under redwood-enterprise-001, same as promo. Good.

aj: Thanks team. If rep can't reapply, can we ask for a credit extension or swap into a contract credit? That would be ideal.

maria: Noted. I'll request extension and conversion to contract credit as part of the case. Will post updates here.

aj: Great. :thumbsup:

maria: Update 2024-05-03 — rep replied, they can reapply promo to Apr invoice if payment was not yet processed; our payment cleared on 2024-04-30, so they offered a one-time reissue of the credit to the next invoice instead. They've queued GC-REDWOOD-PRM-50K to apply to May invoice (adjustment ID ADJ-404). Will monitor.

aj: Understood. Please keep monitoring — we want to avoid wasting the credit.

billing-bot: Auto-log: CASE-20240501-1122 updated by rep. Tags: credit-reissue.

maria: Final: credit reissued to May invoice. Closing case. If anyone sees unexpected charges, ping me.
